summary: Elevate your IT career through our specialized training course in leadership skills. Gain the expertise needed to thrive in the tech industry.
lede: IT leadership development helps technical professionals move into management and gives current IT leaders structured ways to align technology work with organizational priorities. Participants learn to assess team skills and create development plans, communicate technical metrics and risks to stakeholders, and lead Agile or DevOps teams through service changes and incidents. They also practice evaluating vendor and budget choices using return on investment and total cost of ownership.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically engineered for technical professionals stepping into management and current IT leaders seeking structured frameworks to optimize their teams.
modules: IT Leadership Foundations and the SFIA Framework
Strategic IT Communication and Stakeholder Alignment
IT Service Management and Operational Excellence
Managing Technology Vendors and IT Budgets
Synthesizing the IT Strategy and Career Roadmap
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires a working knowledge of general IT operations and technical team structures. Minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical role (e.g., systems administration, software development, network engineering, or IT support). Familiarity with basic IT service management concepts and project lifecycles. No programming, advanced coding, or prior formal management experience is required.
